workload.command: python -I -c "import timeit; from PIL import Image; a = Image.new('L', (2048, 2048), 0); b = Image.open('Tests/images/hopper.png').convert('L').resize((2048, 2048)); c = b.convert('RGB').convert('RGBA'); print(sum(min(timeit.repeat(f, number=20, repeat=5)) for f in (a.getbbox, b.getbbox, c.getbbox, b.getextrema)))"
workload.source: adapted from the %timeit cases in the description of https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow/pull/8194 (getbbox of an all-zero, a normal and an opaque image, and getextrema, all 2048 by 2048), with timeit in place of IPython's %timeit and a test image of the tree in place of the ones the description names

oracle.source: the getbbox and getextrema test modules, for GetBBox.c, the file https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow/pull/8194 changes, run against the installed package; targeted tests only
